purpose: Prevent survivor-subset leakage when historical PIT members are absent from the 2026 current-listed frozen dataset.
required_population: Every restored/delisted symbol that is a PIT domestic-common member on at least one 2024-10-01..2025-12-30 signal date.
daily_repair_order: Direct Yahoo chart API request by historical code, one symbol per request, daily interval with split events.

If unavailable, classify whether the historical code was replaced by a successor/predecessor identity through merger/share-transfer/code change using official JPX/company evidence. Alias may be used only when economic/security identity continuity and date mapping are explicitly verified.
If no valid Yahoo identity path exists, search a free historical OHLCV source and preserve provider/source receipt. Do not use strategy returns to select the provider.
If required historical daily data still cannot be recovered, fail closed before V47 strategy scoring.
intraday_repair_order: Direct Yahoo chart API range=730d interval=1h by the PIT historical code.
Verified query alias only when official identity continuity is documented and raw timestamps/relative price path can be mapped without inventing bars.
Targeted refetch of missing required symbol-dates.
No interpolation/backfill of missing OHLCV bars.
prohibited: Do not remove missing restored names and rerun performance.
Do not choose alias/provider based on return performance.
Do not change NOCAP/CAP1000 price-policy rules because a missing-data path is inconvenient.
Do not use 2026 returns for repair decisions.
